sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law heritage coexisting with French Civil Law elements and customary (kastom) law; International Companies and AML/CFT legislation follow English statutory drafting and judicial precedent
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: WTO Agreements — Vanuatu accession effective 24 August 2012, applying TRIMs, GATS and most-favoured-nation / national-treatment disciplines
Treaty Establishing the Melanesian Spearhead Group and the Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (MSGTA) — active regional trade and investment framework for Vanuatu

Verified status: no comprehensive double taxation agreement and no standalone bilateral investment treaty is in force involving Vanuatu as of the due-diligence date; reliance is placed on Vanuatu's 0% offshore corporate tax regime under the International Companies Act and WTO/MSG disciplines

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act (Act No. 25 of 1992, as amended, including the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2014 and 2018 which abolished bearer shares and mandated beneficial-ownership records together with the VFSC AML/CFT supervisory framework); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 3 of 2016 (as amended) and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations 2017; Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 250]; Trust Companies Act (Vanuatu); United Nations Sanctions (Support) Act (Vanuatu); VFSC AML/CFT guidelines and licensing directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarised certification by a Vanuatu notary, authentication by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalisation by the consular post of the destination jurisdiction (Hague Apostille not applicable in Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Constitutional Instrument (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu notary certification, Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, destination-state consular legalisation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), Sections 6-10 (Incorporation), Section 13 (Memorandum and Articles), Section 17 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), Section 29 (Directors), Section 113 (Fees); subsidiary application of the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 2017 for registry oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Trusts Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 Application for Registration of an International Company, accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and the Registered Agent's Consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares may be denominated in any currency and issued with or without par value. No escrow account is required for formation. Paid-up capital may be credited by consideration, with full disclosure in the Share Register.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Registrar of International Companies be and are hereby adopted, and that the initial subscribers take up the issued shares at fully paid value as recorded in the Share Register; RESOLVED FURTHER, THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that the registered agent be appointed to maintain statutory registers and records; RESOLVED FURTHER, THAT [Director A], [Director B] and [Director C] be appointed as the first Directors, and [Corporate Secretary] be appointed as Company Secretary; RESOLVED FURTHER, THAT the Directors be and are hereby authorized to open bank accounts, to apply to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission for the REIT operating license, and to execute all documents required to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trusts Registry (e-Filing portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the licensed registered agent via the VFSC online registry. Provide the proposed corporate name, confirmation that the name does not imply government sponsorship, and a brief corporate purpose statement confirming real estate investment trust activity. The Registry will check name availability against the domestic and international company registers.
required_dossiers: Brief statement of business purpose (ISIC 6499 / REIT)
Identification of proposed subscriber or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or restricted use, file an alternate name within 5 business days; appeal the refusal in writing to the Registrar of International Companies; administrative reconsideration is typically completed within 3 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and a notary public licensed in Vanuatu or in the subscriber's jurisdiction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the prescribed IC form, including the registered office clause, share capital provisions (authorized shares, no par value option), director powers, and indemnity clauses. The subscriber's signature must be witnessed; notarization or apostille is required for foreign subscribers. The registered agent countersigns the consent to act as agent.
required_dossiers: Subscriber identity documents (passport or national ID)
Proof of address and notarized signature pages
Bank reference or source of funds declaration for the subscribing entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization or apostille is defective, the registered agent will return the documents for re-execution; a fresh signature page may be substituted without re-filing the full charter if executed under a power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Submission and Statutory Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trusts Registry (e-Filing portal or physical counter window).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-01, the executed charter, the registered agent consent, and the applicable government fee (approximately USD 300, plus agent fees) through the VFSC integrated filing system. The application must be accompanied by a declaration of compliance signed by the subscriber or agent confirming compliance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or deficiency notice, the agent has 14 calendar days to file corrected documents or supplementary declarations via the e-portal; if the application fails, paid fees less a nominal administrative charge are credited toward a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique IC number. The Certificate confirms the date of incorporation, the company name, and the liability-limitation status. The registered office address is contemporaneously recorded with the licensed agent's premises in Port Vila. The company then prepares its statutory books and common seal.
required_dossiers: Registered office notice / agent appointment record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical errors, the Registrar will rectify by reissuance upon written request within 2 business days; if the registered agent's license lapses, the company must appoint a replacement agent within 21 days to avoid striking-off.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Governance Instrument Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; minutes filed with the registered agent and maintained at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass the written resolution adopting the charter, appointing directors and the company secretary, approving the issue of founder shares, and authorizing the REIT license application. Minute the resolution in the corporate minute book, execute share certificates, and file director/secretary particulars with the registered agent's statutory records.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and register of members
Declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership (for agent records)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resolution is later challenged for defective quorum, a signed unanimous written resolution may retroactively ratify all acts; rectify director service addresses and beneficial ownership records with the agent and VFSC within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Compliance Division, in conjunction with the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (for REIT/collective investment scheme authorization).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Collective Investment Scheme (Real Estate Investment Trust) License, issued under the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 2017 and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; additional Securities Dealer approval for the REIT Manager.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - EIA Registration / Preliminary Environmental Assessment: required for commercial real estate development exceeding 0.5 ha site area, coastal-zone construction, or properties involving significant excavation; a full EIA Report (Category A) applies only to large-scale greenfield developments near sensitive ecosystems.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent limits of 30 mg/L BOD and 50 mg/L TSS before discharge to municipal sewers; stormwater management per DEPC permit conditions; VOC emissions capped at IFC/World Bank EHS Guidelines levels for building operations; asbestos-free refurbishment mandate and regulated disposal of construction waste through licensed contractors; compliance with the Waste Management Act No. 24 of 2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (Port Vila) verifying emergency exits, extinguishing systems, and evacuation plans; structural load and seismic compliance inspection by the municipal building control authority (Port Vila Municipal Council Building Section) under the National Building Code; workplace health clearance in accordance with the Workplace Health and Safety Act No. 30 of 2017, including hazard registration, electrical safety certificates, and occupational hygiene assessments for property management staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; online services portal: https://www.vrc.gov.vu/. Formation and licensing of International Companies and Real Estate Investment Trusts: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); portal: https://www.vfsc.vu/.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) obtains its statutory identifier from the VFSC rather than from VRC: (1) the beneficial owner appoints a VFSC-licensed registered agent; (2) the agent submits the proposed International Company name, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered address, and license application under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; (3) the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation containing the company/trust registration number; (4) for REIT activity, the applicant applies for a financial services / international trust license and pays prescribed levy; (5) the IC does not receive a TIN because Vanuatu imposes no income tax on ICs; the VFSC registration number, business license number, and VRC customs importer/exporter code (if goods movement is needed) constitute the fiscal identity envelope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the non-resident International Company is excluded from Vanuatu entity-level direct taxation; profits, dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains, and distributions are exempt under the International Companies Act so long as the IC does not carry on local (Vanuatu-resident) business outside permitted offshore activity. It is not eligible for or required to make a pass-through election; it is not a Vanuatu tax resident.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. The IC may elect in its constitutive instruments (and board resolutions) to operate as a single class share company, multi-class share company, segregated cell company, unit trust or bare trust for the REIT portfolio; it may also elect a VFSC-licensed trustee/management company. These elections determine the VFSC licence scope and the rights of investors, not domestic income-tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) — Vanuatu levies a 12.5% VAT on domestic taxable supplies under the Value Added Tax Act; a non-resident International Company is outside the VAT net for offshore REIT services and for income sourced outside Vanuatu, resulting in an effective 0% indirect tax rate for the offshore exempt zone activity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For a local taxable person, the VAT registration threshold is VUV 4,000,000 (annual taxable turnover). For the non-resident International Company REIT, no VAT registration threshold is engaged because the IC has no domestic taxable supply nexus and is not permitted to carry on local business in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not operate a national real-time e-invoicing or fiscal stamping platform. VAT-registered local suppliers must issue prescribed VAT invoices; imports and exports are cleared through VRC's ASYCUDA World electronic single-window system. A non-resident IC has no domestic electronic-invoicing obligation unless it registers for local VAT (which would exceed its permitted IC scope).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For Vanuatu VAT purposes, a taxable person must zero-rate exports of goods evidenced by removal from Vanuatu within the period required by VRC, and may zero-rate certain services supplied to non-residents if the direct benefit is received wholly outside Vanuatu. A non-resident International Company, however, is not a VAT taxable person for permitted offshore REIT activities, so its export character is established by the non-Vanuatu situs of the underlying real estate assets and the non-resident beneficiary base, with no input-VAT recovery required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed via ASYCUDA World / VRC
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing external port of discharge
Commercial invoice and REIT distribution/redemption documentation
Inward remittance certificate, SWIFT MT103 or bank statement evidencing offshore payment
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and REIT/financial services licence
Written mandate from the trustee/investment manager confirming offshore beneficial ownership
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If an IC or its trustee makes VAT-taxable local supplies without registration, VRC can recover VAT, interest and penalties under the Value Added Tax Act, and customs duties plus penalties for undeclared imports. False export/inward-remittance claims are treated as revenue fraud: VRC may impose administrative penalties up to the amount of tax avoided, deny or claw back input VAT refunds, and VFSC may suspend or revoke the International Company REIT licence for breach of the International Companies Act or anti-money-laundering Rules. Investors claiming refunds on prohibited local operations are not protected by the tax-exempt zone.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains no exchange-control restrictions on current or capital account transactions. The vatu (VUV) is fully convertible in both directions for foreign direct investment, portfolio capital, dividend distributions, and loan repayments. Profit remittance is unrestricted and does not require prior central-bank approval, provided the underlying transactions are commercially documented and any required annual fees or licenses are current. Capital proceeds and investment returns may be repatriated freely in the same foreign currency as received or converted and remitted without conversion limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory surrender requirements for export receipts. Vanuatu does not mandate a timeline for repatriation or forcible conversion of export proceeds into VUV. Exporters may retain overseas earnings in freely convertible foreign-currency accounts with an authorised financial institution. Any FX transaction must be reported to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu only through mandated statistical reporting by licensed banks; the transaction itself is not subject to prior approval or conversion ratios.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI providers have limited viability in Vanuatu. The Reserve Bank of Vanuatu supervises all deposit-taking and payment institutions under the Financial Institutions Act and the Payments and Settlements Systems Act. A non-licensed offshore EMI cannot operate in the Vanuatu payment corridor or open accounts with Vanuatu banks without a physical licensed local branch. The practical legal rating for using fintech EMIs is Medium for ancillary disbursement rails subject to full AMLCFT screening of the EMI, and Low for serving as the primary clearing counterparty for a REIT's capital escrow and dividend wires, due to lack of recognition as an authorised financial institution and absence of depositor protection.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical appearance requirement generally applies for newly introduced overseas corporate clients. Vanuatu-regulated banks mandate an in-person director or senior controller interview at the time of account opening for International Companies, particularly when the beneficial owner is non-resident and the company has discretionary trust features. Remote opening is possible only for clients with an existing, low-risk relationship with the bank or through a qualifying correspondent-bank KYC package; in such cases a video interview is accepted but a local registered agent still must attest to the corporate record and beneficial ownership registers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure with nominee directors or bearer instruments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; registered agent certificate of compliance; full beneficial-ownership register; audited financial statements or a sworn capital source declaration; board resolution appointing the account signatories; structure chart showing ultimate natural persons, each with passport and 120-day utility-bill proof of address

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: REIT portfolio containing high-value real property with opaque funding sources
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent KYC-AML compliance report prepared by a licensed agent; title deeds and land office certificates; rent roll and property valuation report; source-of-funds source-of-wealth statements certified by a CPA or attorney-at-law; notarised purchase agreements and transfer deeds; evidence of statutory license and annual reporting under the Companies Act

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividend distribution to mixed trust and offshore beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trust deed or trust instrument and registered trust register; list of named beneficiaries with KYC identity files; distribution calculations and board minutes approving dividends; payment-facing SWIFT MT103 instructions with detailed reference purpose; tax residence certificates of overseas beneficial owners where required

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or debt capital must be wired by the investor's resident bank through SWIFT MT103 to the Vanuatu IC's corresponding beneficiary account. The remittance instruction must contain the International Company registry number, the REIT trust/prospectus reference, and a purpose code that confirms capital subscription or shareholder loan, along with the investor's KYC and source-of-funds documentation held by the receiving Vanuatu bank. The reserve bank's statistical form, where triggered by the receiving bank, must be completed without requiring a prior exchange-control permit. Funds are credited to a Capital Escrow Account pending completion of the VFSC licence validation and are then released into the Operational Account only upon production of the licence and board approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for trade-related real estate services, construction disbursements, and operating expenses are cleared via SWIFT MT103 beneficiary wires, MT202 for interbank transfers where settlement is between correspondent banks, and irrevocable commercial letters of credit for import or sale of construction materials and property equipment. Vanuatu permits settlement in any convertible currency, and banks will process EFT instructions in the designated foreign currency or convert VUV through an authorised dealer using the prevailing interbank rate without exchange-control prior approval.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forwards for lease-denominated foreign-currency receivables
Cross-currency basis swaps for offshore financing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (prescribed form, Section 116 of the International Companies Act Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each registration (incorporation) anniversary; if the anniversary falls on a non-business day, the next business day applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 5,000 (approx USD 43) plus VUV 1,000 for each month of continued default; if the return remains unfiled for more than 3 months, the Registrar may commence administrative strike-off proceedings after serving a 30-day warning notice on the registered agent and directors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Registration Fee (renewal of International Company registration, payable under the International Companies (Fees) Rules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry / Revenue Collection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the registration anniversary date; payment is a precondition for acceptance of the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% penalty surcharge after 30 days of default; unpaid fees for 3 consecutive months authorise the Registrar to strike the company off the register following a 30-day statutory notice; directors remain jointly and severally liable for outstanding fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation and UBO Return (Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Beneficial Ownership Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed concurrently with the Annual Return on the registration anniversary; material changes (share or REIT unit transfers) must be filed within 14 calendar days after the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to VUV 100,000 (approx USD 850) for failure to maintain or file the UBO register; false or misleading information attracts a fine of up to VUV 500,000 (approx USD 4,300) and/or imprisonment up to 2 years; VFSC may also refuse to accept the Annual Return until UBO data is rectified, exposing the company to strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Compliance Certificate (condition of the REIT's VFSC licence under the Securities Dealers Act and related collective investment scheme regulation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Financial Institutions / Securities Supervision Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the close of the financial year adopted in the licence (for a 31 December financial year-end: no later than 31 March of the following year); first statements due within 18 months of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing supervision penalty of up to VUV 250,000 (approx USD 2,150); repeated or egregious default exposes the licensed REIT to suspension or revocation of its VFSC licence and administrative strike-off of the International Company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An exempt Vanuatu International Company has no compulsory audit under the International Companies Act Cap 222. A mandatory annual audit by a Vanuatu-registered auditor arises only where: (i) the company is a VFSC-licensed financial, securities or collective investment entity (as applicable to a publicly offered REIT) and the licence conditions require audited statements; (ii) shareholders holding at least 10% of the voting rights validly demand an audit; or (iii) a creditor, joint venture or unitholder agreement imposes an audit. The licensed REIT in this structure must submit IFRS-compliant audited financial statements to VFSC annually within 90 days of year-end.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu has no domestic GAAP; IFRS as issued by the IASB is the applicable framework for VFSC-recognised reporting entities (including licensed REITs). Exempt International Companies may maintain simplified accrual-based accounting records under Section 79 of the International Companies Act provided they reflect the financial position with reasonable accuracy and allow the annual return to be verified.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021, the International Company must maintain a register of beneficial owners at its registered office, identify all individuals holding more than 10% of shares, votes or REIT units (or otherwise exercising control), file initial and updated UBO returns with the VFSC Beneficial Ownership Registry within 14 days of any transfer, and confirm the accuracy of the UBO register annually together with the Annual Return. The registered agent must sight and retain supporting evidence (identification documents, trust deeds, unit transfer instruments) for each beneficial owner and report discrepancies to VFSC.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders or REIT unit holders)
Register of Charges, Mortgages and Encumbrances

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,500 per annum for a standard licensed registered agent and registered office retainer; USD 1,200 - 2,500 per annum for premium agents providing REIT-specific secretarial, UBO and VFSC licence liaison services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - 8,500 per annum for a certified IFRS audit by a Vanuatu-registered auditor for the licensed REIT; nil for an exempt unaudited International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu is a zero corporate income tax jurisdiction; an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 is statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and dividend tax on its worldwide profits.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption (IC Act s.10): no income tax holiday or preferential deduction schedule exists because no income tax base exists. The only recurring fiscal charges for a compliant IC are the annual VFSC government fee (calculated on authorized share capital) and the annual return filing fee. The 12.5% VAT is a consumption tax chargeable only on taxable supplies made in Vanuatu; a compliant offshore IC makes no domestic supplies, and REIT rental income from overseas real property is therefore subject to a 0% effective income-side tax rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return (VFSC Standard Annual Return for International Companies) filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal and countersigned by the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within two months (60 days) after each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee falls due on the same date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered company name, IC registration number, date of incorporation, and the Vanuatu registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the stated name matches the certificate of incorporation exactly; any change to the registered office must be pre-filed on the prescribed change form before the annual return is submitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number, and electronic countersignature of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A change of registered agent must be separately filed within 14 days; the annual return is invalid without the agent's signature.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Directors, Shareholders and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, nationality, share class and number of shares, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration for each natural person controlling 25% or more of the entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must provide certified passport copies and proof of residential address; nominee directors must expressly declare their nominee capacity and identify the controlling principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, has not derived Vanuatu-source revenue, and holds no Vanuatu land or domestic investment assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a REIT holding overseas income-generating real property, tick the no-Vanuatu-source-activity declaration; a false declaration triggers deregistration, penalty assessments, and director liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission incurs a VFSC late fee plus a daily surcharge on the outstanding government fee; continued default leads to administrative strike-off, automatic forfeiture of the statutory tax exemption, inability to operate bank accounts, and court-ordered restoration penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (the single statutory VAT return form) lodged via the Vanuatu Revenue Portal (VRP) - mandatory only if the IC has registered for VAT, which is not required for a pure offshore IC making no domestic supplies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly as assigned by the Commissioner of Customs and Revenue
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than one month after the end of each assigned tax period; the net VAT payable must accompany the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT chargeable on taxable supplies made in Vanuatu during the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An offshore REIT reports nil output VAT; zero-rated export-style services, if any, are stated in the separate zero-rated schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible VAT paid on imported goods and local business expenses used for taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input credits require a valid VAT invoice; if the entity makes exempt financial services, input VAT must be apportioned and only the taxable-use portion claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 15 - Net VAT Payable or Refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT less input VAT credits for the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A registered person must file even a nil return; failure to submit a nil return attracts default penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default penalty of 25% of the unpaid VAT plus statutory interest; fraudulent evasion attracts a penal assessment of up to 200% of the evaded amount, daily late-payment surcharges, and imprisonment on conviction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: CRS/FATCA Financial Account Report (OECD XML Schema) submitted through the VFSC CRS/FATCA reporting portal - applicable when the REIT is classified as an Investment Entity (Financial Institution) under the Common Reporting Standard.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: By the gazetted annual CRS/FATCA filing date (typically 31 July) in respect of the preceding calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity, tax residence, and taxpayer identification number of each controlling person and reportable account holder resident in a CRS participating jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident UBO data must reconcile with Part C of the IC Annual Return; certified passports and foreign TINs for each non-resident investor must be collected and retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Account balance or value, income paid, and gross proceeds credited to each reportable account during the calendar year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident REIT investor, passive rental income distributions and sale proceeds must be reported to the investor's country of tax residence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Monetary penalties per unreported account, daily default fines, potential revocation of the IC's tax-exempt status, and adverse rating by the OECD Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu law imposes no withholding tax on dividends, no branch remittance tax, and no exchange control restrictions; distributions from an International Company to non-resident shareholders are paid free of any Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network; it has concluded only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) and is a participant in the OECD CRS Multilateral Convention. Because the statutory withholding rate is already 0%, no tax-residency certificate (TRC) or administrative treaty relief claim is required for outbound dividends. If the foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction grants an indirect foreign tax credit or participation exemption, the shareholder should obtain from the VFSC registered agent a certificate of tax-exempt International Company status and annex board-approved distribution resolutions as supporting evidence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate: 0% for cross-border royalties (including REIT management, brand, and intellectual property licensing fees) and 0% for debt interest. Treaty rates: not applicable because Vanuatu has no DTA. Practical caution: a separate 12.5% VAT may apply to locally performed management or technical services physically rendered in Vanuatu, and the foreign recipient's home jurisdiction may independently impose withholding on the cross-border payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, no thin-capitalization rules, and no statutory documentation threshold expressed in Vatu (VUV). Prudent international standard for an exempt offshore REIT: prepare contemporaneous economic-substance and transfer-pricing files (Master File and Local File) whenever annual intercompany management, advisory, or financing charges reach or exceed VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 84,000), because Vanuatu banks and correspondent financial institutions apply OECD-aligned due diligence even absent a domestic TP statute.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted a standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) statute applicable to ordinary International Companies; the ESR doctrine is enforced indirectly through the IC Act's offshore-conduct prohibition, VFSC licensing supervision of registered agents and intermediaries, and OECD/FHTP monitoring. An income-generating REIT should maintain: a physical registered office in Vanuatu; a licensed registered agent; books and records kept at the registered office (IC Act s.57); annual board meetings evidenced by signed minutes; and strategic control exercised from Vanuatu. Absence of these indicators re-characterizes the entity as a shell and exposes it to VFSC deregistration, blacklisting, and loss of the statutory tax exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing false VAT or CRS returns, issuing taxable invoices without VAT registration, under-declaring output VAT on domestic supplies, or destroying financial records to conceal Vanuatu-source activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penal assessment of up to 200% of the evaded VAT plus statutory interest; criminal fine and imprisonment for fraudulent evasion; asset freezing orders and travel bans under the Proceeds of Crime Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are criminally liable on conviction; civil restitution orders compel repayment of evaded tax; courts may impose travel restrictions and disqualification from managing companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Nominee-only directorship, no physical office in Vanuatu, no locally held books and records, no board governance, and use of the IC merely as a conduit envelope for a foreign-owned real estate portfolio.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative strike-off and deregistration; forfeiture of the IC statutory tax exemption; mandatory re-registration as an ordinary domestic company subject to 12.5% VAT and all local charges; adverse listing on international blacklists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for company debts contracted during non-compliance and for statutory penalties; nominee directors face VFSC license revocation and aggravated fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed REIT / Unauthorized Collective Investment Scheme
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Soliciting third-party investor funds, issuing units or securities, or managing a pooled real-property portfolio without the VFSC securities license required under the Securities Dealers Act Cap. 130 and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist orders; monetary fines per contravention; criminal conviction for unlicensed dealing; court-ordered restitution of investor funds; deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and fund managers are jointly and severally liable for investor losses; key personnel may be imprisoned and permanently banned by VFSC from carrying on financial services.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct customer due diligence, failure to identify ultimate beneficial owners, failure to file suspicious transaction reports, or absence of the mandatory record-keeping regime under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 4 of 2020.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fines scaled to the severity of the breach; revocation of any financial services license; criminal money-laundering penalties including substantial fines and imprisonment; asset freezing and travel bans.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability, civil penalties, and asset confiscation; foreign travel may be restricted pending proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Domestic Trading While Holding IC Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acquiring or holding real property in Vanuatu, supplying services to Vanuatu residents, maintaining a Vanuatu business establishment, or deriving Vanuatu-source income contrary to the IC Act s.2 international-business restriction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the tax exemption; retrospective application of all Vanuatu taxes on income and transactions; administrative penalties; compulsory conversion to an ordinary local company; deregistration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Statutory officers are personally liable for unremitted taxes and penalties and may be prosecuted for carrying on business without lawful registration.
